name: Azuregos's Magical Ledger
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: You cannot understand a single word on this ledger. You don't even know what language it is written in!
narrative.objectives: Deliver Azuregos's Magical Ledger to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
narrative.offerRewardText:
<Narain eagerly examines the letter.>

Outstanding, friend! What is it? I can't read a lick of Draconic.
narrative.requestItemsText: Ooooh! Magical pulsing thingy! For me?

chain.subtitle: 18 quests at level 60, 102,100 XP in all.

quests.name: Azuregos's Magical Ledger
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Azuregos's Magical Ledger to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Stewvul, Ex-B.F.F.
quests.objectiveText: Narain Soothfancy wants you to find his ex-best friend forever (BFF), Stewvul, and take back the scrying goggles that Stewvul stole from him.

quests.name: Never Ask Me About My Business
quests.objectiveText: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to speak with Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Draconic for Dummies
quests.objectiveText: Find Narain Soothfancy's book, buried on an island in the South Seas.

quests.name: Scrying Goggles? No Problem!
quests.objectiveText: Find Narain's Scrying Goggles and return them to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Isle of Dread!
quests.objectiveText: Recover Lakmaeran's Carcass and 20 Chimaerok Tenderloins for Dirge Quikcleave in Tanaris.

quests.name: rAnS0m
quests.objectiveText: Return the Ransom Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Love Song for Narain
quests.objectiveText: Take Meridith's Love Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops
quests.objectiveText: Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan wants you to bring him 20 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 20 Deeprock Salt.

quests.name: Decoy!
quests.objectiveText: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to travel to Winterspring and place the Bag of Gold at the drop off point documented by the booknappers.

quests.name: Return to Narain
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the 500 Pound Chicken to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Only Prescription
quests.objectiveText: Recover the 8 lost chapters of Draconic for Dummies and combine them with the Magical Book Binding and return the completed book of Draconic for Dummies: Volume II to Narain Soothf

quests.name: The Good News and The Bad News
quests.objectiveText: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to bring him 20 Arcanite Bars, 10 Elementium Ore, 10 Azerothian Diamonds, and 10 Blue Sapphires.

quests.name: The Wrath of Neptulon
quests.objectiveText: Use the Arcanite Buoy at the Swirling Maelstrom at the Bay of Storms in Azshara.
